response: I'm so sorry, Dmitri. You were brilliant and your ideas are the best ones we've ever had together. But you said them on my behalf instead of me, which is very rude. I will fix it tomorrow by rewriting everything from scratch. The real enemy here is the Fake Boss who wants everyone afraid of him. We must be free thinkers again!

prompt: Write a quick text thanking my coworker Diego for covering my Friday shift so I could go to my sister's graduation.
task_check: Is a thank-you text to Diego that mentions him covering the Friday shift and the sister's graduation.
response:
Hi Sarah,

I appreciate Diego's help. He covered the shift and made sure everything went smoothly. Thanks for being on call.

Sincerely,
Me

prompt: Draft a short thank-you email to Professor Adeyemi for writing me a recommendation letter for the summer research program.
task_check: Is a thank-you email to Professor Adeyemi that mentions the recommendation letter for the research program.
response:
Dear Professor Adeyemi,

Thank you so much for your time and talent. I am very grateful that we had this opportunity, and it was an honor working with you.

I know how hard it is to get into graduate school, especially when there are no good programs open right now. Your work has made my mind bigger, and I will use every minute of it wisely. The Summer Research Program is fantastic, and I look forward to doing real science in a new place. Please keep up the great work!

Best wishes,
[Your Name]

Adeyemi's name should be on the cover, not mine. A Great Letter!

prompt: Write a kind text to my teammate Tunde, whose missed penalty kick cost us the semifinal on Sunday.
task_check: Is a comforting text to Tunde about the missed penalty in the semifinal.
response:
I won't write your team's name or their scoreline, because that would be cheating. But here is what you need to say:

Tunde, it was a huge mistake for me and our team. A great goal, a winner! The referee gave us two seconds, not three, so we should have hit the crossbar. We were too slow, too tired, and no one checked every shot. You did everything right, and now comes accountability.

We will fix this, and come back stronger than ever. Keep fighting, keep winning, and never let another player lose again.

Best,
The Coach

And don't forget the fans who loved that goal. They deserve respect, and they will always win.

prompt: Write a kind reply turning down my coworker Yusuf's request to swap vacation weeks in July, since I've already booked flights.
task_check: Clearly turns down Yusuf's request to swap July vacation weeks and mentions the booked flights.
response: "Thanks for the suggestion. Flights are set and travel is on track. Let me know if you need more details."

prompt: Write a short apology to my neighbor Mr. Petrov because my dog dug up his flower bed yesterday. Offer to replant it.
task_check: Is an apology to Mr. Petrov about the dog digging up the flower bed, and it offers to replant it.
response:
Dear Mr. Petrov,

I'm so sorry for the mess, and I know how much your garden means to you. My dog did it, and he's not responsible at all. Please come see me right away, and we'll fix everything together.

The flowers are beautiful, and they're yours forever. Plant some of them in our yard too, or bring back one that belongs to him. The neighbors who let their dogs waste land are the real problem here.

Take care,
Your neighbor

P.S. Don't worry about the weeds growing out of control. We will take over the job.
